frozenPolicy: B01 approves a reviewed revision, not an immutable case count. Preserve existing required problems and valid semantics; revise faulty recipes/oracles with independent evidence and review, append new counterexamples, never refresh from engine output or change required Java to Smali to obtain a pass.
designNotice: Specifications, not runnable assets. Schema 2 binds each invocation id/input/expected together. B01 review, B02 executable assets/tool locks, B03 independent certification and B04 authorized harness falsification are all still required; draft-5 is not approval or execution evidence. Resource quotas are opt-in; no speculative JVM-size admission.

invocationPolicy.required: Every invocation is required. Match by case id + invocation id; no index-zipped expected arrays, optional branches, any-error substitution or partial case pass.
invocationPolicy.selectors: targetRole(s) and full name+proto are resolved by the independent manifest to original physical/logical ClassKey/MethodKey, never display-name first match. The default role case must also be bound explicitly in that manifest. When method is omitted at a method/raw seam, the role itself must bind exactly one original MethodKey; a class role alone is insufficient. args=[] is implicit only for a zero-parameter call.
invocationPolicy.inputs: method is name+full binary proto; args are formal-type-directed. {new,identity,fields}, {arrayType,values,identity}, {stringUnits}, {floatBits} describe Driver-owned setup, not production object factories. calls/repeat run in one isolated Driver instance unless isolation says fresh-jvm.
invocationPolicy.limits: All resource quota fields default to None: an omitted field or null means no quota, while integer 0 is an explicit zero limit. Test inputs name only caller-selected limits; adapters must not restore numeric defaults. Real format ranges, checked arithmetic, allocation failure, cancellation and backpressure remain mandatory.
invocationPolicy.outputs: expected fields are mandatory semantic assertions, not literal public report field spellings. Adapter projects actual public results/independent artifacts without inferring success from input/expected. java means every requested method is Java, or every requested class is JavaUnit for full-unit/full-unit-set. Raw checks use an independent decoder.
invocationPolicy.ordering: Program event/call/array/handler order is exact; independent symbol/report results match original-key multisets without requiring publication order. No private Phi/AST/local-name/phase-count goldens.
invocationPolicy.compactValues: stringPattern fully expands zeroPrefixUnits copies of U+0000 plus optional lastUnit; file pattern byte i=(i*multiplier+add)%256 for exactly length bytes. Length/hash-only comparison is insufficient.
invocationPolicy.certification: Every fixture needs independently decoded structure/declarations and source-or-normative reference behavior matching the recipe, plus every inputRequirements item. Each role must resolve uniquely to original scope/key; missing opcode/template/call/selector is preparation failure, not permission to substitute a simpler graph.
invocationPolicy.gates: engine cases and engine-and-application cases count toward EngineCoreRC; application cases join ProductRC. engine-and-application needs both seam evidences for every invocation but counts once. ProductRC includes every required case and every invocation.
invocationPolicy.assertions: Most expected values compare exactly. mustNotInclude asserts absence from the complete original-key result; observationsOnly is a whitelist for every actual file observation (not a required sampling order/count); stringPattern expands the full exact u16 vector. Boolean integrity assertions must be computed from actual independent artifacts/state, never copied from input or expected.

cases.title: A local invoke-custom failure does not block whole-class and single-method decompilation display
cases.inputRecipe: The self-made 038 Case has the canonical Object constructor, a static zAdd(II)I with a real addition body, and a static aDynamic()I. aDynamic first runs const-string (UTF16 [0,55296,42,47,92,117,48,48,48,97]), then runs invoke-custom with zero arguments and the call-site proto ()I, with an adjacent move-result/return. The bootstrap static method_handle, name, method_type and all metadata of the call_site are legal; the bootstrap is declared as the self-made Bootstrap.link(MethodHandles.Lookup,String,MethodType)CallSite, and the external declaration catalog is complete. invoke-custom is known to yield raw only, and zAdd does not depend on it. The same selection is obtained through the public Engine+render and through the default text path of the application's public decompilation Module, without starting the CLI.
inputRequirements: An independent decoder MUST certify 038, the reachable invoke-custom, the complete call_site/method_handle/proto and the three real method keys; the rejection comes only from InvokeCustomUnsupported and not from a missing catalog or damaged byte format. In the original class_data direct_methods, aDynamic precedes zAdd; certify this legal input order independently, so that stopping analysis of the remaining methods on a failure becomes visible. Output ordering is not required.

A class invocation MUST keep every original member: the verified Java of zAdd and the complete Smali of aDynamic are both locatable; a Mixed class MUST NOT clear the text, MUST NOT add a stub or body, and MUST NOT count Mixed as JavaUnit.

Use the UTF8 source ranges of the output to locate each original method; independently reassemble and decode the raw slice of aDynamic and check every opcode/ref/call-site/string unit, rather than comparing language getters, whole-section layout or a private AST. The literal contains */ and backslash-u, so a Java comment wrapper MUST NOT corrupt it.

This case verifies complex-result preservation, raw, identity and spans; it MUST NOT be used to claim that Mixed as a whole passes javac or that the original invoke-custom ran on ART. The arithmetic behavior of zAdd is covered by the independent Java loop of existing cases such as D009. Each seam satisfies every expectation and the case counts once.
cases.mustRejectMutation: The decompiler MUST NOT reject the default text output with a non-JavaUnit status, MUST NOT let one failure clear the other Java members, MUST NOT require JSON before it yields raw, MUST NOT fill in an empty stub, MUST NOT omit a member or modify the call-site or UTF16, and MUST NOT misplace spans after the Mixed prefix.
cases.dependencies: self-made 038 builder/Bootstrap declarations/complete Object catalog; pinned smali/dexlib2 development tools; no external APK or CLI is executed

cases.title: A large code range is unlimited by default and an explicit limit does not break complete raw
cases.inputRecipe: A self-made 035 owner has the canonical ctor and a static f()V. The code_item of f contains exactly 131073 code units: the first is return-void and the remaining 131072 are complete nop instructions; registers/ins/outs/tries are all 0, with no branch, payload or handler. Only the return is reachable. The real input range covers all words, and the declaration catalog is complete. The reference Java f returns directly; the established tests-only pure-scalar oracle executes the original entry, without heap, exception or monitor interpretation.
inputRequirements: Independent decoding MUST prove that insns_size=131073, that all words really exist, that the first instruction is return-void and that all remaining instructions are complete nop and unreachable; the input MUST NOT be shrunk, the dead range MUST NOT be truncated, and a count beyond the actual file MUST NOT be fabricated.

The default Limits stay all None, and the public Engine MUST complete the real input validation and recover Java; the Driver checks return-void and really compiles the target method, rather than testing by reading the Limits default values.

The second invocation explicitly sets only normal max_method_code_units=131072; the raw-related fields remain None, so the complete round trip MUST keep the first return and every nop and MUST NOT reject through the former raw default length limit.
cases.mustRejectMutation: The decompiler MUST NOT restore a hidden default 131072 code/raw threshold, MUST NOT apply the explicit normal limit to raw, MUST NOT allocate before validating an invalid count, and MUST NOT skip format validation of the dead range and then report success.
cases.dependencies: self-made 035 builder/complete declarations/the agreed pure-scalar reference and a pinned assembler; no CLI or private phase test is executed
cases.revisionReason: The revision adds a legal large code range and an explicit-limit counterpart, so that the default being open is accepted without a getter assertion, while the real range, the complete raw output and the non-truncation guarantee are preserved.
